services.desc: A private double decker pontoon for up to 12, with a licensed captain, a proper changing room, and a water slide off the top deck. Nobody has to drive, and nobody has to get changed behind a towel. First: there's a private changing room on board. This is genuinely rare on a rental pontoon in Kelowna, and it's the thing groups tell us they didn't expect. It means getting into a swimsuit without an audience and sorting yourself out mid-afternoon, rather than queueing for a beach change room. Second: a certified captain drives.
